decision_candidates.text: PostgreSQL remains the source of truth for the ledger; Kafka events are transport and workflow coordination, not the authoritative balance store.
decision_candidates.original_text: Okay. We have enough to write the record. The only final decision is PostgreSQL remains the authoritative ledger store, while the rest of the rollout details remain pending.
decision_candidates.reconstructed_text: The team confirmed that PostgreSQL remains the authoritative ledger store, while Kafka events are transport and workflow coordination, not the authoritative balance store.

decision_candidates.text: Use a rolling update with maxUnavailable set to 0 and maxSurge set to 1.

notes: the last decisive utterance is an explicit leave-open/unresolved statement
